scores.tell: Cauldron body is uniformly smooth satin plastic with soft vague highlights; stone floor tiles are noisy, grainy painterly texture, more realistic than real cards.
Marble-like streaks on table and stools, plus grass blades and path pebbles drawn as fine painterly noise. Too much texture, little gloss; unlike the smooth real cards.
Dark navy locomotive has clean metal with crisp rivets and glossy red wheels, near the real look. Tell: grainy wood sleepers and dusty desert noise.
Same scene as c106 with veiny marble scratches on the stone and busy grass strokes. Texture scale is fine and noisy, with little gloss variation.
Silver saucer has smooth metallic gradients, glossy green dome and glowing rivets; gloss range and finish match the real cards. Nothing stands out.
Calculator has soft matte-satin navy keys, glossy cyan keys and a dull screen. Gloss is mixed and the edges are smooth. Almost none.
Purple roof and stone walls are smooth clay-like, with little fine detail. Window glow is good. Slightly uniform satin everywhere, and the stone has no grain.
Orange clock rim is glossy plastic with strong highlights, dial matte, dots with small gloss. Mixed gloss, but rim is a little too lacquered.
Same clock with an even glossier orange rim and a beveled glass edge. Highlights are broader and lacquered, and the dial has a faint grainy edge.
Cat has fuzzy matte velvet fur with visible grain, unlike the glossy statue lesson or the real cards' smooth finish. Wood planks have large knots and stipple.
